etymology: from 206 and probably a modified form of posthe (the penis or male sexual organ)
avSummary: uncircumcision 16, being circumcised 2, uncircumcised + 2192 1, though not circumcised 1
definition:
1) having the foreskin, uncircumcised
 2) a Gentile
 3) a condition in which the corrupt desires rooted in the flesh
    were not yet extinct
